summary: Frontend-only mobile regression verified series settings, odd 3-board selection, manual rotation visibility/action, and set rollover at the public Expo preview.

ui_bugs.issue: The active header is hard-coded to display 'BOARD NN OF 08' even when a 3, 5, or 7 board set is selected.

action_items: Use match.boardsPerSet in the active board progress label instead of the fixed 08.
Expose current set and set score in the active UI; the state advances correctly but users cannot see set score/current-set progress.
critical_code_review_comments: History items use board.number as the React key, but board numbering resets to 1 at each set, creating duplicate keys after rollover and potentially unstable history rendering.
Final-set board-4 crossover condition is implemented in completeBoard, but there is no visible crossover/status indicator to verify the special event for users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, series settings opened from the header; Best of 3, 3 boards, and manual rotation were selectable. After setup/toss, manual-rotate appeared and tapped successfully. Completing 3 boards advanced to board 1 while the series remained active. No browser error elements appeared. Screenshot showed history count 3 and active board controls.
rca_of_issue: Active.tsx-equivalent inline component renders the progress string with literal 'OF 08' (index.tsx line 66), independent of match.boardsPerSet. Set score/currentSet are maintained in Match state (line 49) but never rendered. History key is only b.number while numbering restarts on each set (lines 49 and 68).
